title: The Heist Where Thieves Stole a 'Seismograph'—to Fake an Earthquake and Empty the City
hook: They didn't need guns—they needed a fake tremor. The whole city evacuated, and they walked into every empty bank.
why_this_can_go_viral: The use of science to commit a crime is both brilliant and terrifying—a perfect blend of intelligence and darkness.

title: The Unsolved Murder Where the Victim Was Found in a 'Room Inside a Room'—Built After They Died
hook: The body was sealed in a hidden chamber—but the walls were built around them, meaning the killer was still there when the police arrived.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that the killer was on-site, possibly watching the investigation, is spine-chilling and creates endless speculation.
